claims.assertion: Gosia describes a physical, multiracial Federation founded by Andromedans, Arcturians, and Lyrians after Lyra’s Great Expansion.
claims.speaker: Gosia (lesson)

claims.assertion: Gosia says Federation authority is layered: local Earth politics center at Andromedan Viera behind the Moon, with higher decisions extending to Saturn.
claims.speaker: Gosia (lesson)
claims.qualifiers: Lower levels may not know higher-level activity.

claims.assertion: Gosia portrays the Federation as non-monolithic: many local members are benevolent, while hidden upper levels lack transparency and may conflict.
claims.speaker: Gosia (lesson)
claims.qualifiers: She resists a simple good-or-bad judgment.
